name: Hampshire Controls Corporation
old_description: Established in 1976 and based in Dover, New Hampshire, Hampshire Controls is a leading designer and manufacturer of supremely reliable “Made in the USA” monitoring, logging, and alert status notification systems for demanding applications.
about:
Hampshire Controls Corporation was established in 1976 in Dover, New Hampshire. The company designs and manufactures monitoring, data logging, and alarm notification systems for demanding applications, emphasizing "Made in the USA" reliability.

The product line includes NIST-traceable temperature monitors and alarms (configurable with 2 to 8 channels), cryogenic temperature monitors, multi-probe condition monitors, the T° Sentry ALERT data logging and alarm system, Wi-Fi temperature transmitters, biomedical freezer backup systems (liquid CO2 and liquid nitrogen), LN2 level monitors, laboratory air flow monitors, and remote alarm delay modules. Manufacturing services encompass PCB soldering, cable manufacturing, subsystem interfacing, final electronic assembly, electronic testing, burn-in, and NIST-traceable calibration, all performed at the Dover facility. The firm also provides custom mechanical and electrical engineering, firmware development, and communication protocol implementation (BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.).

Hampshire Controls serves blood banks, cryogenic biologic storage facilities, vaccine and genetic research laboratories, biopharma production plants, governmental agencies, hospitals, commercial food processing and storage operations, and industrial manufacturers. It also supplies original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) with high-volume temperature monitoring and alarm systems for clinical, food and beverage, water distribution, plumbing, and industrial markets.

The company differentiates itself through in-house design, manufacturing, and calibration capabilities, allowing it to offer both standard and custom-engineered products with NIST-traceable calibration. Its systems are UL LISTED and built to meet NEMA/IP ratings for harsh environments.
